steps.text: Hey
Are you busy right now?
No, not really
Why?
I have almost finished setting everything up
I made your professional account and filled in most of the details
Already?
Was it complicated?
No, do not worry
It went fine
I also made sure to mention that you have a manager on the account
So I will be the one handling reservations, messages, and the annoying parts
That actually reassures me a lot
I was worried I would have to deal with all of that myself
No, that is exactly why I am helping
But I do need something from you
What do you need?
Some photos of you for the profile
A few different ones would be better
The profile has to look attractive enough for people to click
Photos...
I am not sure I really know how to do that
Or what I am supposed to wear
You do not have to rush
Just look for a few outfits and try what feels right
Okay
I will check my clothes and try to send you a few pictures later
Take your time
And trust yourself a little
You are already gorgeous
You always know what to say...
Thank you
I will try my best
